row.body: Lesson dates stop at the county road closure; the house key is tied to the page beside a note to keep the fee for the missed lessons. No return date is written.
row.title: Road closure practice

sidecar.gloss: A lesson page and key preserve the dates and household cost of a road closure.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could have closed the road for work nearby and left the key with a lesson note; nothing here says what forced the closure.

row.body: the tire pump is tied to the first-aid kit by a clipped lanyard. an empty loop shows where an identifying tag was cut off.
row.title: missing count beside the tire pump

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

row.body: Please keep the lesson room shut until the roadside spray test is over. The children can still hear the truck from the front room; their mother has paid for the whole week already.
row.title: Closed windows

sidecar.gloss: A lesson moves indoors while a roadside field test continues.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have tested roadside treatment after a closure; closed lessons and a prepaid week do not show what the spray was meant to control.
